question: Two circular pizzas have radii in the ratio 2:3. If the smaller pizza has an area of 100π cm², what is the area of the larger pizza?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of areas = (Ratio of radii)²

Area ratio = 2² : 3² = 4 : 9

Given 4 units = 100π cm² ⇒ 1 unit = 25π cm²

Area of larger pizza = 9 units = 9 × 25π = 225π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 225π cm².**
